Comi-Cog 1.0.0 – AI-powered comic and manga creator using CellCog

- Create manga pages, webtoons, comic strips, and graphic novel art with character and style consistency.
- Requires CellCog SDK skill for setup and API calls.
- Offers prompt patterns for generating comics, with support for both single-page and multi-page narratives.
- Provides detailed guides and prompt examples for character description, comic styles, layouts, and genres.
- Supports "agent" and "agent team" chat modes for different comic creation needs.
